title: palicourea verrucosa

This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Palicourea verrucosa include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
